notes: Run lamarr-euro-2026-10-22 (European archives pass for the turning-point rooms). Collotype postcard of the graves of honour section of the Zentralfriedhof (Vienna Central Cemetery), around 1905; holder statement 'CC0' with the reuse note 'You can download and reuse ... this image under the condition of CC0'. Chapter 10 (death and legacy); LAM-F-0038 (buried in a tomb of honor at the Vienna Central Cemetery) is single-source, so the room is a lead until it is corroborated. Her grave (2014) is not in the picture.

Wien Museum object pages are plain-fetchable and carry 'CC0'; Döbling postcards (Peter-Jordan-Straße 82 hospital, Hochschule für Welthandel) found, but no verified fact names Döbling or a street, so none staged for chapter 1

query: sammlung.wienmuseum.at "Am Himmel" Döbling Ansichtskarte OR Fotografie

notes: main gate, arcades, mortuary halls, graves of honour postcards (CC0); 'Situation der Gräberanlage für berühmte Männer' plan 131330 is a further lead
'Himmel' 600959 is an 1811 watercolour (not a photograph); Grinzing Himmelstraße postcards (1939 and earlier); LAM-F-0037 (Am Himmel) is single-source and names no building: none staged
